title: Disney 100: A Century of Dreams – A Special Edition of 20/20
overview: Commemorating the 100th anniversary of the entertainment company with interviews, rare footage and photos, and never-before-heard stories from those who built the Disney legend; a look inside Disney's newest attraction.
